description:
Get one company's BORME timeline: its published registry events within your
plan's window.

Use it once the company is known (a slug from search_companies or
company_by_nif); across many companies use search_events. A name is
searched too: several matches return {ambiguous: true, candidates}, none
returns {error, suggested_companies}.

Returns JSON {company_slug, total_events, first_seen, last_seen, truncated,
next_offset, count, events} (as in search_events), with former_slugs for
a merged company (an old slug returns the merged timeline) and
plan_window on a limited plan. total_events, first_seen and last_seen
cover the whole timeline in your window, not this page. To page,
keep limit and order and pass next_offset as offset (at most 10000)
until it is null.

Read-only; one request per call. Without an API key (X-API-Key header) only
the last 7 days; basic covers 365 days, pro and risk the full history
back to 2009. If all its events are outside your window, the refusal
counts them.

company.description: Company slug, e.g. vaz-metales-sl (from search_companies), or a name of at least 3 letters or digits, e.g. "Mercadona", searched case-insensitively.
company.title: Company

offset.description: Events to skip, integer 0-10000 (default 0); pass the previous page's next_offset, e.g. 100.
offset.title: Offset

order.description: "desc" (default, newest first) or "asc" (oldest first), e.g. "asc" to start from the earliest event in your plan's window.
order.title: Order

name: company_history
title: Company registry timeline
